design_packet_ref.concern: Full Standard design: receipt schema delta, re-fire flow, circuit breaker, adjudication call justification, slice horizon

material_concerns.summary: The existing --correction-mode block only forces one retry: learning_capture_hook.py unconditionally allows on a re-fired Stop event (stop_hook_active: true) regardless of whether the flagged problem was fixed.
material_concerns.resolution: Addressed directly in the design's section 3 re-fire flow: the re-fire path now checks for a compliant Learnings marker or a contest marker instead of blanket-allowing.

material_concerns.summary: One-contest-attempt circuit breaker (section 4) is a recommended default, not a derived fact -- a real product/policy choice.
material_concerns.resume_condition: Brian dispositions accept/revise/reject/delegate on the one-attempt bound before slice 2 (the adjudication call) is implemented.

material_concerns.summary: Whether Claude Code's own Stop-hook re-fire mechanism has an independent hard ceiling on repeated blocks is unverified and must not be assumed.
material_concerns.resume_condition: A real test observes the actual re-fire ceiling before slice 2 is wired live, per section 4.

next_slice_refs.concern: Slice 1 (fully_specifiable_now): schema extension + deterministic re-fire check, no LLM call, implementation-ready
